purpose: V-002 R-278 / ADR-0131 rule 6: recovery-alone activation is measured by each verifier's own observation interval; Home/custodian timestamps cannot accelerate it.

models.claim: R-278: no verifier accepts a recovery-alone successor before observing the request for the full delay; live controllers are never overridden; a seen veto blocks acceptance
R-278 holds per verifier even when controllers do not react (withheld or delayed vetoes)
mutation: trusting a deliverer's age claim is the acceleration attack R-278 forbids
golden: a late verifier waits its own full interval after another verifier accepted
T-090 residual: withholding from every live controller lets a partitioned peer accept after its own interval; fork detection on contact is the mitigation
